name: The Millennials Kyoto
detail: This is the only capsule hotel in Kyoto that has a mixed floor, meaning a floor for both guy & girl which is convenient for a couple like us travelling as we don't want to be on different floor for the night. The room is just a bed with all the remote & key being the Ipod that was passed to you during check in. The troublesome thing is to make sure the ipod is fully charged at all time if not, it will affect on how you can control the light, air & stuffs. There is a place for everyone to mingle & eat. Cups & plates are also provided but do remember to do your own washing once you are done.

name: THE POCKET HOTEL Kyoto-Karasumagojo
detail: This has got to be the best budget hotel I've ever been to! I think their kiosk for check-in and check-out is nice and convenient to use. The room size of the single room was perfect and private. It's soundproof so I can sleep soundly or talk freely on the phone. I even get a really nice view of the city from my 9th floor room. The bed was very comfortable and easy to assemble for sleeping. I didn't have to fuss around to put in the sheets. The shared bathroom and shower was so clean and well maintained. I also love how there's cups at the side so I can drink water. The shower stall is actually bigger than I expected which is great. Staff are very helpful and nice. I had some mishaps but they gladly helped me each time. Overall, the whole hotel is very pristine, and even for a low price, I got such a good experience with their service. You can tell that this hotel paid attention to every single detail their target market needs. Solid 10/10 for me.

name: Livemax Hostels Kyoto Ekimae
detail: Great location excellent price and amazing service

name: Hotel SUI Kyoto Kiyomizu
detail: There is even a hotel shuttle back to Kyoto station.

name: Hotel Elcient Kyoto Hachijoguchi
detail: Specifically booked this hotel due to its proximity to Kyoto Station. Just across the road in fact. Was pleasantly surprised that it is not only near to Kyoto Station, but it is also situated on the JR station side, which means we do not have to walk the length of the station to get to the Shinkansen station to Tokyo. Best located (for my purpose) hotel for me and my small family. There is a kimono rental shop just at the entrance and the selection was small but very beautiful. I personally did not rent from there but from what I can observed, it is a convenient place to start for your kimono experience. They charged around 3900 yen when I was there. There is a small Lawson right across the street from the hotel, in case you came back late from your excursion and in need of refreshment. The shops at Kyoto Station generally close at 10PM. name: GLANSIT KYOTO KAWARAMACHI
detail: I booked the superior capsule and it's the best capsule I had so far in Japan. Unlike most capsule, I don't need to check out of my room if I stay for multiple nights here and there's also option to choose for cleaning service for the superior capsule (no extra charges). It's like a mini hotel room with your own desk and door and bed... but without a lock. To me that's good enough because the price is great! Bed wise is very comfortable, not too noisy with a huge TV screen. It's comparable to a sky suite. Locker is huge enough for you to put your luggage in as well as your bags and others items (you have upper and lower storage space in the locker). The capsule although within about 5-10 mins walk from train station, its location is great as situated opposite Takashimaya and the most happening street in Kyoto and next to Gion. I will definitely come back here again to stay if I want save some costs on my accommodation in Kyoto and yet comfortable enough.

name: TSUKIMI HOTEL
detail: - Location: Such a perfect location. It's located in heats of Gion where is the most historical Area in Japan. - Facility: Completely brand New, and clean. Staffs are working hard to keep clean. The mattress is perfectly comfortable. (didn't want to wake up!) There are 3 floors as: Only for man, Only for woman, man and woman mixed. We are 5 ppl man and woman mixed group, so stayed at Mixed floor. 1st floor is entire free space for everyone. We enjoyed there with cooking, and drinking. - Staff: All staff are such a nice and friendly. They are very nice and friendly, so every time we back to hotel, we felt like coming back to our home! We guess there's nothing to better than this hotel (hostel) in Japan. Strongly recommend. We will back here soon!

name: Sotetsu Fresa Inn Kyoto-Hachijoguchi
detail: This hotel was a jem, just a 5-7 mins walk to the main Kyoto station. The hotel feels very very new and rooms were well cleaned. However, we had the hotel lobby staff unable to converse in English thus we had a hard time trying to communicate with them. Although there was a language barrier, the staff had remained professional and patient while I tried to articulate my needs. At this moment, Sotetsu Fresa Inn Kyoto is the number one of my list of hotels in Kyoto.

name: Almont Hotel Kyoto
detail: We spent 5 nights at the Almont whilst in Kyoto. Hotel has everything would need for a comfortable stay although there is no gym which was a pain! Staff are excellent, very helpful, friendly and accomodating. Hotel is located 5 mins walk from kyoto station, rear entrance. It's a quite and friendly part of kyoto and only 10 minutes walk to the front end of kyoto station where you will find all the shops, hassle and bustle etc Rooms are on the small side, which is the case for majority of hotels in Japan. A little disappointed with the breakfast but other than that a great and convenient little hotel with great staff.

name: Sotetsu Fresa Inn Kyoto-Kiyomizu Gojo
detail: Make sure you try the Kyoto Bancha Porridge, a specialty!
